assumptions: Closed orders are identified by orders.status = 'closed'
Quantity is summed from order_lines without adjustments for returns or shipments
sql:
SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o USING(order_id)
JOIN products p USING(product_id)
WHERE p.category = 'fasteners' AND o.status = 'closed'
